subject: Checkout failures during peak: confirm impact window & propose proportional remedy
messages:
From: Samir Desai <samir@brightcart.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai
Cc: tina.huang@brightcart.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Checkout failures during peak: confirm impact window & propose proportional remedy

Hi Michael,

We saw a sharp spike in failed checkouts and elevated latency during our morning peak today. Our monitoring shows a cluster of 503 and 429 responses hitting our flow between 08:40 and 09:02 PDT; this resulted in roughly ~12% of checkout attempts failing (attached is a CSV summary and a screenshot of the spike).

Impact summary:
- Region: us-west-2 (usw2)
- First observed: 2026-06-19 08:40 PDT
- Last observed: 2026-06-19 09:02 PDT
- Failure mode: intermittent 503s and elevated token-generation latency (per the app logs)
- Business impact: increased checkout abandonment during peak; estimated revenue exposure ~$18k for the window

Could you confirm whether this qualifies under the SLA availability calculation and start an evidence collection? We will need:
- confirmed downtime/degraded window from Redwood side
- details on affected endpoints and error-classification
- proposed compensation / proportional remedy under our current contract

I've attached the aggregate CSV and a short screenshot. I can also upload a trace bundle if you need request IDs. We need an initial acknowledgement and ETA for the postmortem.

Thanks,
Samir Desai
Ops Lead, BrightCart
[sent from mobile]

[attachment: brightcart_screenshot.png (image/png)]
[attachment: brightcart_failure_summary.csv (text/csv)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@brightcart.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during peak: confirm impact window & propose proportional remedy

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the quick summary. I'm escalating to SRE (Laura) and engineering (Rishi) to validate the telemetry.

Quick asks from our side to speed validation:
- Can you attach one or two sample request IDs (the ones you referenced in the CSV) and a short trace bundle (ZIP) if available?
- Were you on Hosted API or a Dedicated pool for the affected workload?
- Any additional downstream errors from your side (payment provider logs) that line up with 08:40–09:02 PDT?

We will:
- Pull raw ingress/egress metrics for usw2 and correlate with your timestamps
- Provide an initial eligibility assessment for proportional remedy per the SLA within 24 hours
- Open an internal incident ticket and provide a timeline for the RCA/postmortem

Acknowledged, we'll treat this as high priority.

—Michael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[attachment: request_log_links.txt (text)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@brightcart.com>, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during peak: confirm impact window & propose proportional remedy

Hi Samir / Michael,

Thanks — Laura from SRE here. We'll start by pulling platform-side metrics and traces for US-WEST-2 for the 08:30–09:15 PDT window to get ahead of correlations. A few clarifying items that will help us narrow the scope quickly:

1) Please provide 2–3 example request IDs (or the full trace bundle) — request IDs allow us to join your traces against ours.
2) Confirm whether the requests were pinned to a model variant (e.g., rdl-7b-quant) or using a fallback policy.
3) If you have any client-side logs that show retry behavior or payment gateway errors, please include them.

Initial next steps:
- I'll open INC-9876 internally and attach telemetry pulls. Expect the ticket number back to you in the next email.
- We'll run a preliminary eligibility check against the SLA policy for proportional remedy; if we identify a confirmed service-degrade window attributable to Redwood, we'll propose a pro-rata credit calculation.

If you can drop the trace bundle to the Drive link you sent or directly to our secure intake link, we'll fetch it.

Laura Bennett
SRE — Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood_trace_request.txt (text) — contains secure intake link instructions]

From: Samir Desai <samir@brightcart.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during peak: confirm impact window & propose proportional remedy

Hi Laura — attaching the trace bundle and a CSV with per-minute failure rates. Sample request IDs: rc-20260619-8a3f, rc-20260619-8b2d, rc-20260619-8c1e. We were on Hosted API (no dedicated pool) and using the rdl-13b variant.

Notes:
- We observed retries from our client which increased apparent latency, but the underlying error class in our logs is a 503 coming from the Redwood endpoint.
- Payment provider logs show successful tokenization for many of the failure timestamps, suggesting the error is upstream.

Can you confirm receipt and give an ETA for the first-pass eligibility check and whether Redwood will be able to bundle a proposed credit amount? We need this for our finance reconciliation.

Thanks — I uploaded the bundle to your Drive folder and included the file here.

Samir

[attachment: brightcart_trace_bundle_20260619.zip (application/zip)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@brightcart.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during peak: confirm impact window & propose proportional remedy

Samir — appreciate the bundle and the sample IDs. Confirming receipt and next steps:

- Internal incident opened: INC-9876 (link: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/54321).
- SRE has the traces and will validate an impacted window; expected initial eligibility assessment within 24 hours of this message (we aim to be faster).
- If the event is attributable to Redwood, we will apply the proportional remedy calculation defined in section 4.2 of the SLA and provide a draft credit amount and timeline by EOD Monday (2026-06-22).
- We'll produce a postmortem (RCA) and remediation items within 5 business days; if we need more time for deep-forensics (e.g., kernel-level investigation), we'll give a status update and interim findings.

For visibility — I included a short telemetry snapshot we pulled from ingress logs for the suspected window. That will be attached to the ticket.

If you need an expedited commercial adjustment before the technical review completes, I can start a provisional credit proposal based on the 12% failure rate you reported; please confirm if you want me to proceed.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
